name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary detention of EU citizens Javier Marañón Montero and David Rodríguez Ballesta in Equatorial Guinea
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns the detention of two Spanish citizens, Javier Marañón Montero and David Rodríguez Ballesta, held in Equatorial Guinea since January 2025. It calls for their release from pre-trial detention, urgent medical care and evacuation for Mr Montero, and access to lawyers and family. It also asks EU diplomats to push harder for their release and urges Equatorial Guinea to improve its human rights record.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its opinion and makes requests.
- The two detained Spanish citizens and Equatorial Guinea's government are affected.
- EU diplomats and Spain are asked to step up efforts; no deadline is set.
